wiki.title: John Daniel Cherry
wiki.extract: John Daniel Cherry (born May 30, 1985) is an American politician. He is the son of politicians John Darrell Cherry Jr. and Pam Faris, and the nephew of politician Deborah Cherry. He is a member of the Michigan Senate from the 27th district and is a member of the Democratic party. He previously served two terms as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives from the 49th district.
